Committed

Privacy Policy

Effective June 30, 2026

Committed does not collect, track, sell, or share any personal data. The app contains no analytics, advertising, or third-party tracking.

Information stored on your device

The commitments, dates, milestones, and settings you create are stored locally on your device. This information stays on your device unless you enable iCloud backup.

iCloud backup

If you enable backup, your data is synced to your private iCloud account using Apple’s iCloud service. It is stored in your personal iCloud account and governed by Apple’s Privacy Policy. The developer cannot access, view, or retrieve your iCloud data.

Purchases

Committed offers a one-time in-app purchase called Lifetime Unlock. Apple processes the purchase through the App Store. The developer does not receive or store your payment information.

Face ID

If you hide commitments behind Face ID, authentication is performed on your device by Apple’s system. Your biometric data is never accessible to the app and never leaves your device.

The calculator on this website

The sobriety date calculator runs in your browser. The date you enter is not saved, transmitted, or added to the page address.

What the developer collects

Nothing. The app contains no analytics, advertising identifiers, or crash-reporting SDKs. It makes no network connection to a developer server.

Children’s privacy

Committed is not directed to children and does not knowingly collect personal information from anyone.

Changes

If this policy changes, the updated version will be posted here with a new effective date.
